interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] I need you to hold something for me. Just until morning.
[color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] This slip goes with my debt book. I will leave the book here too. Keep them behind the counter.

response_choices: Why not give it to Officer Phuc?

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] The police are searching houses. Loose pages get lost when strangers handle them.
[color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] Everything I have collected is in that book. People trust you. It will be safe here.
[color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] Do not open it. If anyone asks, you never saw me tonight.
